description: Two formation blocks (previous, current) and eight party members. Scene notification gate 0x68517c is 0 (messages are UI only); renderer object 0x68edcc is a zero block so 0x5b1c80 and 0x5a24a0 take their no-UI paths; 0x590950 runs natively on synthetic ':' / ':%s' texts. Region/slot bytes the original uses as table indexes are kept within the formation block (out-of-block indexing is undefined in the original). Previous-block cells are unique so 0x554bd0 assertions are not hit. No executable table or bytes are embedded.
